records.title: International Political Economy
records.header: BISGST 324 International Political Economy (5) SSc, RSN
records.text: BISGST 324 International Political Economy (5) SSc, RSN The study of interrelations between international politics and economics. Addresses the Bretton Woods institutions, differing political conceptions of international economic relations, trade, trade restrictions, trade agreements, global financial flows, migration, and exchange rates. Methods emphasize institutional analysis, historical analysis, accounting frameworks, and formal economic models.
